requirements.general_text: The programme is accessible to a wide range of applicants, with various pathways for admission: Pass Malaysian Certificate of Education (Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia – SPM) with at least credit in THREE subjects; OR Possesses SKM Level 3 in the related field; OR A Certificate (Level 3, MQF) in the related field with at least a CGPA of 2.00; OR A pass in Malaysian Higher School Certificate (Sijil Tinggi Pelajaran Malaysia- STPM) with at least grade C (GP 2.0) in any subject; OR A pass in Malaysian Higher Religious Certificate (Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia – STAM) with at least a Maqbul Grade; OR Other equivalent qualifications recognised by the Malaysian Government International students Pass IGCSE O-level or equivalent with at least grade "C" in THREE subjects
